seo.title: Solar panel, heat pump and EV charger installer on the French Riviera | Soliance
seo.description: Soliance installs solar panels with batteries, heat pumps and EV chargers in the Alpes-Maritimes, Var and Bouches-du-Rhône. Detailed study, fixed price, installed by our own technicians, first-year maintenance included.

hero.title: Renewable energy you can trust.
hero.lead: Solar panels with batteries, heat pumps and EV chargers, installed by our own technicians. Every installation starts with a detailed study of your consumption, your household and your home. Fixed price, paperwork handled, first-year maintenance included.
hero.leadShort: Solar panels with batteries, heat pumps and EV chargers, installed by our own technicians. Detailed study of your household, fixed price, paperwork included.
hero.imageAlt: Contemporary villa with solar panels, photographed for the Soliance project library

partners.title: Our partners
partners.logosAlt: Partner logos: SolaX, Francilienne, K2, Daikin, Sofinco, MMA, BPCE Lease, RI2E, Synexium

solutions.title: Our solutions
solutions.intro: Three kinds of equipment, one team: we design, install, connect and maintain.

solar.title: Solar panels
solar.description: 3 to 12 kWp, always with a battery: you use your own electricity in the evening instead of selling it off to the grid. Town hall, Consuel and Enedis paperwork included.
solar.shortDescription: 3 to 12 kWp, always with a battery, paperwork included
solar.imageAlt: Villa equipped with solar panels, swimming pool

heatPump.title: Heat pumps
heatPump.description: Air-to-air or air-to-water heating and cooling, sized after a study. Eligible for MaPrimeRénov' and CEE: we prepare the grant application.

evCharger.title: EV chargers
evCharger.description: 7 to 22 kW chargers, at home or in company car parks, driven by your solar production. IRVE-qualified installers.
evCharger.imageAlt: Wall-mounted charger in front of a garage, electric car charging

simulator.title: How much could your roof save you?
simulator.lead: Address, roof area and electricity bill: in two minutes you get an estimate of production, savings and recommended power. No commitment.
simulator.leadShort: Address, roof area, bill: an estimate in two minutes.
simulator.imageAlt: Roof fitted with solar panels at sunset, French Riviera
simulator.estimateLabel: Sample estimate for a typical house

study.title: A detailed study for 100% of projects
study.description: Your actual consumption, your household profile and the technical features of your home: nothing is sized by default.
study.descriptionShort: Consumption, household, home: for 100% of projects.

quote.title: Meeting & quote
quote.description: Presentation at home or at the showroom, technical visit, detailed fixed-price quote.

paperwork.title: Paperwork
paperwork.description: Town hall declaration, Enedis connection, buy-back contract: we handle everything.

installation.title: Installed in 1 to 3 days
installation.description: By our own technicians, never subcontracted. Consuel inspection and commissioning.

followUp.title: Monitoring & maintenance
followUp.description: Monitoring app, check-ins at 6 months and 1 year, first-year maintenance included, then Soliance Care.

why.title: A local team that stays after the installation.
why.body: We have been installers on the French Riviera since 2022. Our technicians do the installation themselves, our showroom is open in Saint-Laurent-du-Var, and every installation is monitored by Soliance Care, our supervision and maintenance service.

trust.title: Trust
trust.description: A fixed price, no surprises, before you sign.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Surplus buy-back is close to zero: we say so, and we size for self-consumption.

proximity.title: Proximity
proximity.description: Showroom, local technician, answer within 48 hours.

why.imageAlt: The Soliance team in front of the showroom
